title: Home for a niche the sample does not cover (food, pets, electronics, auto parts, services)
when: The store sells something no niche recipe describes. The sample leans to fashion and beauty, so start from this structure rather than bending a fashion recipe.
evidence: not counted: these niches are absent from the sample or too rare to count (a store or two at most); built from the universal skeleton and the catalog-led recipe

steps.when: one commercial promise on a dark bar: the usual choice
steps.note: Delivery terms are the usual promise here; only the merchant's.

variants.when: a soft brand tint (kids, beauty, playful and premium looks)
2-3 short service promises the merchant confirmed

steps.when: a short flat menu and a left-aligned look (journal, dense catalog)
steps.note: Then stack `header-touch-one-row` for a single phone row. `catalog-two-row` instead for large assortments (electronics, auto parts).

variants.when: a flat menu of up to 6-8 short items: the categories show on desktop
a large assortment: catalog button, mega menu, wide search

steps.when: photography with a quiet zone for the live text

variants.when: a catalogue look: the hero inside the grid with the theme's rounding
a photo and a colour panel side by side (playful, premium)

steps.note: Real categories, linked, 2 per phone row. Its title is a phrase about what the store sells: the storefront makes it the page's H1 (a banner title never is).

variants.when: more than 4 categories
two departments or audiences (women and men, adults and kids)
one curated row of 4

steps.when: considered purchases: 3-4 real numbers (years, customers, materials) (kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: The signature block: one block that only this store has, chosen by the look (references/looks.md).

variants.when: dark drop and playful: a running line of short brand words (kit-custom-sections)
premium and beauty: one real review set large (kit-custom-sections)
native fallback: the store's real facts as text cards alternating with photos

steps.when: bigger cards for the second source, a change of rhythm

variants.when: one curated row of 4
new arrivals or bestsellers, 12 cards

steps.when: the default story: eyebrow, a heading phrase, 16 px text at 560-640 px, a button to a real page, a 1:1 or 3:4 photo (`mediaRatio`; kit-custom-sections)
steps.note: One story block in the middle third that leads somewhere: a button or a last-line link to the catalog, a collection or the About page.

variants.when: native fallback the merchant edits in the cabinet: a narrowed section, `###` heading, one paragraph of 300 characters or less ending with a link
no photo for the story: one centred statement of 100-200 characters ending with a link

steps.note: Delivery, storage, compatibility or booking questions that the merchant answers.

variants.when: service answers as untitled rows under the last grid (left-aligned themes)
a rounded theme (playful, soft): the questions on one card

steps.when: text left, form right: the usual closing band

variants.when: a centred form on a neutral band (centred themes)
on the footer palette, so the subscription and the footer read as one closing block
off-white, grey or cream: soft and premium looks

notes: Food and pet goods: `layout-soft-friendly`, packshots on one backdrop, delivery and storage in the FAQ.

Electronics and auto parts: `layout-boxed-catalog`, `product-catalog-led` for the product page; the platform filters are the category tree, price and stock, so specs go in the characteristics and the category tree.

Services, or a shop that also takes custom work: the directions as two entry tiles under the hero (`entry-tiles-pair`), past work as a tile carousel (`collection-carousel-overlay`), and a banner with a button (`linkType: button`) to the contacts page or `tel:`. There is no native form; a request form is a custom section that kit-custom-sections does not offer yet.
